而且，这只狐狸还拉着她的衣服喊娘亲？
生出一只狐狸也就算了，刚出生的狐狸就能口吐人言？是不是在欺骗她读书少？
“你是谁？”
憋了半天，白颜才憋出了这三个字。
“娘亲，宝宝饿。”
小狐狸一双眼睛萌萌的，干净而懵懂，正可怜巴巴的凝望着白颜。
本来还在郁闷生了一只狐狸的白颜，彻底的被这只小狐狸给萌化了……
“宝宝饿，吃奶奶。”
小狐狸扒拉着白颜的衣服，慢悠悠的爬到她的身上，色色的小爪子一下子就撩开了她的衣服，慢吞吞的吮吸了起来。
吃饱之后，小狐狸很是享受的打了个饱嗝，安心的在白颜的怀里闭眼休息。
白颜看着在自己怀里睡着的小家伙，心底的那一处柔软被触动了，眸子逐渐温柔：“你是我十月怀胎生下，所以，不管你是谁，都是我倾尽一生也要保护的儿子。
此刻她还不知，因为孩子的出世，万兽朝宗，造就四方云动。
“国师，国师！”
豪华的宫殿之中，少女快速的向着正在夜观星象的男子冲了过去，她的脸色满是激动：“刚才是不是有万兽朝宗的景象？连我们妖界的这些妖兽都被震动了，这是不是证明我有小侄子了？”
国师看向这冒冒失失的少女，笑了笑：“公主殿下，我之前把王送去的地方，就是王后将会出现之地，不过我没有如实告诉王，现在看来，王已经寻到了王后，并且下一代的妖界之王也出生了。”
这么多年来，王一直都未娶妻，连妾都没有，就因为一道预言，他必须在等待着自己命中注定的妻子，也只有那个妻子，才能为王繁衍下后代。
可这么多年来，那女人一直都没出现。
就在前不久，他观测到星象云动，王后将要来到这个世界，是以，他找到准确的地点后，便直接将王丢了过去。
“太好了，我王兄终于告别了多年的处-男之身，”小公主激动的跳了起来，她一把抓住了国师的胳膊，撒娇道，“国师，将我也送到大陆去呗，我要去见王嫂和小侄子。”
“小公主，我是趁着封印薄弱的时候把王送了过去，你若是想要去，我得找时机。”国师无奈的笑了笑，眼神有些宠溺。

小公主俏皮的吐了吐舌头：“行，等你找到机会，就让我去找王兄和王嫂，还有我可爱的小侄儿。”
或许是侄子的出生，让小公主很兴奋，向来喜欢缠着国师的她没有再做过多纠缠，而是在他那溺爱的眼神向着前来的方向走去。
可惜，她没有走多久，便被一道倩丽的身影拦住了去路。
“你要干什么？”小公主没有好气的问道。
“公主，王真的去找那个女人了吗？”
这是一个长得很妖媚的女人，如同玫瑰似的，美艳芳菲。
“她是我王兄命中注定的妻子！我王兄不去找她，还找你不成？”小公主小脸一沉，愤愤的瞪了眼女人。

content_en:
Moreover, this fox also pulled her clothes and called her mother?
Even if a fox is born, a newborn fox can speak human words? Are you trying to trick her into not studying well?
"Who are you?"
After holding it in for a long time, Bai Yan finally managed to utter these three words.
"Mom, the baby is hungry."
The little fox had cute eyes, clean and ignorant, and was staring pitifully at Bai Yan.
Bai Yan, who was still depressed about giving birth to a fox, was completely adorable by this little fox...
"Baby is hungry, eat grandma."
The little fox tugged at Bai Yan's clothes and slowly crawled onto her body. His slutty little paws immediately lifted up her clothes and started sucking slowly.
After eating, the little fox burped happily and closed his eyes to rest peacefully in Bai Yan's arms.
Bai Yan looked at the little guy sleeping in her arms, the softness in her heart was touched, and her eyes gradually became gentle: "You were born in my tenth month of pregnancy, so no matter who you are, you are the son that I will protect with all my life.
At this moment, she still doesn't know that because of the child's birth, all the beasts have moved towards the clan, causing clouds in all directions to move.
"National Preceptor, National Preceptor! "
In the luxurious palace, the girl quickly rushed towards the man who was observing the stars at night. Her face was full of excitement: "Did you see the scene of thousands of beasts coming to the sect just now? Even the monsters in our monster world were shocked. Does this prove that I have a nephew? "
The Imperial Master looked at the reckless girl and smiled: "Your Highness, the place where I sent the king before is where the queen will appear, but I did not tell the king truthfully. Now it seems that the king has found the queen, and the next generation of the king of the demon world has also been born. "
For so many years, the king has never married a wife, not even a concubine. Because of a prophecy, he must wait for his destined wife, and only that wife can produce offspring for the king.
But for so many years, the woman never showed up.
Not long ago, he observed the movement of the stars and clouds, and the queen was about to come to this world. Therefore, after he found the exact location, he threw the king directly there.
"Great, my brother Wang finally bids farewell to his virginity for many years." The little princess jumped up excitedly. She grabbed the arm of the Imperial Preceptor and said coquettishly, "National Preceptor, please send me to the mainland as well. I want to see Mrs. Wang and my nephew. "
"Little princess, I sent the king there while the seal was weak. If you want to go, I have to find an opportunity. "The Imperial Master smiled helplessly, his eyes a little doting.
The little princess stuck out her tongue playfully: "Okay, when you find a chance, let me find Brother Wang, Sister-in-law Wang, and my cute little nephew. "
Perhaps it was the birth of her nephew that made the little princess very excited. She, who had always liked to pester the Imperial Master, did not bother her too much, but walked towards the direction with his doting eyes.
Unfortunately, she didn't go long before she was blocked by a beautiful figure.
"What are you going to do? "The little princess asked angrily.
"Princess, has the king really gone to find that woman? "
This is a very charming woman, as beautiful as a rose.
"She is my brother Wang's destined wife! If my brother Wang doesn't go to her, why don't I go to you? "The little princess's face sank, and she glared at the woman angrily.
